expected_value_creation: A case-grounded expert judgment framework will let organizations convert tacit judgments into reproducible decision patterns, derive quality intents, and preserve evidence-backed review behavior across humans and AI.
beneficiary: Quality owners, successor staff, domain specialists, cross-functional reviewers, and AI agents that need explicit judgment logic
supporting_evidence: The framed request defines concrete-case judgment, cue extraction, concern mapping, loss boundaries, counterexamples, and reproduction tests as the usable path.
QIF already models quality intent, evidence, and verdicts, so the missing value is the upstream extraction layer for tacit judgment.
success_criteria: Decision patterns include cues, concerns, loss boundaries, evidence requirements, applicability boundaries, exceptions, and counterexamples.
A non-expert or AI agent can apply patterns to unseen cases with acceptable agreement.
Derived Quality Intents remain challengeable and governable rather than frozen as expert authority.
